svg.title: Phase 1, Stage: eleven scripts set up one pull request with no model
svg.desc: Eleven scripts run in order with no model, in three bands. The ledger band checks the tools, creates the ledger, resolves settings from five sources, a project file allowed only to raise, add, or set and any command it brings held for your approval, and sweeps closed runs. The read band fetches the diff from the API, or builds it from the clone when GitHub serves none, splits it per file, runs deterministic probes whose hits are leads, classifies the change and its size, asking or parking when it is over the warning, and names open pull requests touching the same hunks, asking whether to go on. The check-out band makes a detached worktree, review-only for a fork that refuses edits and a stop when the fork is gone, gathers local standards, and runs the project's check once as the baseline that arms the fix loop's gate. A terminal shows the line each script prints; the ledger shows what each writes.
svg.text: four scripts before anything is read
a worktree, your rules, a baseline
Eleven scripts, one line each; a model joins only to judge an overlap. Every input is on disk before review.
the orchestrating session sees one line per script

text.tspan: resolved 24 default 21 user 1 project 1 local 1 run 0 ignored 0

g.text: a hit is a lead only
open PRs on the same base
a pass arms the fix gate
the project file brings a command
go on, or park? you say
gate disarmed, tail kept as evidence

svg.text: a fallback; the run goes on
stops or parks; a number is the exit code
